English: Steam Tent
A makeshift felt tent, heated with hot stones and steam, to provide warmth and comfort for nomads on the move.
Hot Stone Hut
A sturdier hut lined with clay and stone, where hot rocks are used for steam baths, easing the aches of travel and battle.
Heated Pavilion
A large, mobile pavilion with improved insulation and a communal hearth, providing warmth and a gathering space for the clan.
Stone Bath Chamber
A semi-permanent bathhouse with stone walls and a domed roof, offering heated baths that strengthen unity and vigor among the steppe folk.
Changing Room
A dedicated chamber for keeping garments dry and secure, increasing the comfort of bathhouse visitors and attracting more of the clan to gather.
Warm Hall
A grand communal hall with radiant heated floors and ornate interior, where clan leaders meet and guests are entertained in comfort.
Scented Bath Room
A luxurious bath chamber filled with aromatic herbs and oils, boosting clan morale and attracting foreign dignitaries.
Private Bathhouse
An exclusive bathhouse with secluded pools and personal attendants, reserved for the khan and honored guests, increasing prestige and clan loyalty.
Family Bath Hall
A lavish, multichambered hall for entire clans to gather, fostering unity, health, and prosperity throughout the host.
Arabic Grand Hammam
A monumental, marble-clad hammam inspired by the finest Arabic traditions, a wonder of the steppes offering unmatched luxury, unity, and hospitality to all.
